"""List rotation."""


def rotate(items, k):
    """Rotate `items` left by `k` places, always returning a new list."""
    return items[k:] + items[:k]

original_test_src:
from rotate import rotate

def test_wraps():
    assert rotate([1, 2, 3, 4], 5) == [2, 3, 4, 1]
    assert rotate([1, 2, 3, 4], 9) == [2, 3, 4, 1]
    assert rotate([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
def test_negative():
    assert rotate([1, 2, 3, 4], -1) == [4, 1, 2, 3]
    assert rotate([1, 2, 3, 4], -5) == [4, 1, 2, 3]
    assert rotate([1, 2, 3, 4], -4) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
def test_small_k_and_empty():
    assert rotate([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [2, 3, 4, 1]
    assert rotate([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
    assert rotate([], 3) == []
    assert rotate([], -3) == []
def test_new_list():
    src = [1, 2, 3]
    out = rotate(src, 0)
    assert out is not src
    out.append(9)
    assert src == [1, 2, 3]
